title: It Is an Honor to Say "We Are Descended from Adam"
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Zid habeebaka yaa Rabb`izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, sultaanan wa ridwaana. A`oodhu Billahi
min ash-Shaytani 'r-Rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem! As-salaatu wa salam `ala Sayyidina
Muhammadan wa `ala man tabi`ahu bi ihsaan ila ‘l-yawmi 'd-deen. Yaa Allah, Ant Allah. Yaa Allah, Ant
Allah. Yaa Allah, Ant Allah. Yaa Allah, Ant Allah. Yaa Allah, Ant Allah. Huwa al-`Azeezu 'l-`Aleem. (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa Saahib az-Zamaan. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa `ibaadAllah as-saaliheen. O holy
ones! Salutations to you and from you to us weak servants. Madad yaa Sayyidee, yaa Sultan al-Awliya. We are
asking for your holy support. If you are leaving us with our physical personalities, we can't do anything except
run after our dirty egos' pleasures!

O People! We are not coming to make our egos pleased and in pleasure. That is the mentality of Mankind
now. It has changed because they are asking to follow Shaytan and its followers and our heedless Muslim
territories, Muslim countries and Muslim people by name only are running after being westernized. Their
main target now, in the Muslim world, is to be westernized Muslims.
O our Salafi `ulamas! Ahlan wa sahlan, Welcome! What is your opinion? Are we speaking wrongly or is it the
truth? If you say it is not true, you will be thrown upside down into hells! It is 100% true to make clear the
identities of the Muslim world. The whole Muslim world is asking to have a westernized mentality. Ptuuh,
spit on that! Dirty ones ask to be like westernized people. Throughout all religions, a westernized lifestyle is
dirtiness, as it makes people to not believe in anything, to become only commodities in this materialistic
world. Leave such beliefs!
O our Attenders! As-salaamu` alaykum! I think you understand. Even if only one-hundred people
understand and say this is Truth, they will be saved here and Hereafter. We have not been paying attention
until now because of our lifestyles, but at last we are trying to understand more and more, because different
heavenly declarations are coming to wake us up daily.
Wake up, O Muslim world! Second, wake up, O Christians! Third, wake up, O Jewish brothers! Wake up and
look at which way you are running or stepping. Say, what was the first heavenly message brought through
Adam (a)? Nowadays, no one believes in Adam, peace be upon him. All nations and their education systems
are based on false nonsense and the dirty theory of Darwin. They say, "We don't believe in Adam, but we
believe in the new theories which Darwin brought based on jungle people, because he says our grandfather
was a gorilla!" Darwin was so happy to come from gorillas' ancestors! Arabia, Egypt, Turkey, Sudan, Libya,
Arabian countries and all the countries of the Christian world, as well as all Jewish people are saying
Darwin's theory is very famous and we must follow it. But what about your books? What is this foolishness
which Mankind believes in?
Ptuuh, spit on those people who are leaving prophets and following a gorilla's generation, Darwin's theory! Is
it an honor for you to teach in all your schools that Man comes from apes? Is it not a shame for you, Muslim
countries' shaykhs and mulooks? Why are you not looking into what they are teaching in your schools? Until
then, there will be no honor for you here and Hereafter!

Adam, peace be upon him, was the first man, first teacher, first prophet, and first messenger from Heavens!
Then came hundreds and thousands of holy ones from among the heavenly ones, coming with heavenly
messages to Mankind, saying, "That first man was created in Paradise and crowned deputy of the Lord of
Heavens." They are not saying this; rather, they are saying, "We are westernized people." Westernized people
are becoming monkeys; is that your honor for Muslims? It is a big blame for Muslim countries! Leave
Christians and others, as they are also on the wrong way by saying that Darwin's theory is okay. Where are
popes, bishops, kings, queens and emperors; are they accepting to be from monkeys' ancestors? Perhaps they
are not emphasizing this, but it is written on the Heavenly Preserved Tablets!
Governments are also not looking into what they are teaching youngsters in schools. They are ashamed to say
that we are descended from Adam! They think that is a blame for them and that it is an honor for them to say
our ancestors are gorillas. That is to be westernized. If you are denying one point from the Holy Qur'an, you
will be kicked out from imaan, from the circle of Islam, thrown away!! As for the cursing that is coming on
nations, that is the reason. Don't think that troubles in Palestine, Syria, Iraq, Arabian countries, Egypt, Sudan
and other places, are a simple problem. It is a big problem for a simple reason: they are saying we come from
gorillas!
There are perhaps forty kinds of monkeys in the world, so many. Why then are people quarreling with each
other? One person from Baghdad asked an Egyptian, "Why are we quarreling?" He answered, "We are
quarreling because we are more honorable than you, because our grandfather was a gorilla, but your
grandfather was only a chimpanzee. The king of the monkeys is the gorilla! So we want to cut off your head."
Europeans say, "We don't come from the Earth, we come from the Heavens."
I am asking Christian learned people, do you think it is written in the New Testament that you descend from
Heavens to Earth? Did you come with a lift (elevator)? If you are heavenly ones, why are you quarrelling and
fighting? You are liars! If you ask Jewish people from where they came, they say, "We came from Abraham's
line."
If you came from Sayyidina Abraham's line, why are you quarreling? And you say we are "cousins". Do
cousins kill cousins? Who is teaching you to kill each other? They say, "Who taught Cain to kill Abel is our
teacher now. Therefore, Israelis are representing Qabil's line and Arabs are representing the Habil's line.

Because of this, we are always going to quarrel and there will be no peace among us."
Do you think what Qabil did to Habil is not true? If not, why don't you follow the right way? Why don't you
try to give people pleasure? The Lord of Heavens said through His most beloved servant, Sayyidina
Muhammad, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen: (Mawlana Shaykh stands):
•••• ••••••• ••••• •••••• ••• ••••••
Afdal al-`amaal idkhaal as-surroor ila qalb al-mu'min min al-iman. For you to make someone happy and
smile to him is from faith. (ibn Hibban)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits) O Salafi `ulamas! What is your position; is this true? How many people are you
making happy, O Salafi `ulamas? "The best of actions is to make happiness enter the heart of a believer." Ask
your mulook and umaraas and shaykhs daily, how many people do they make happy? Say! You can't say it,
because they are not doing that. That hadith embodies the highest level of humanity: "The best one of you is
whoever is giving pleasure to Mankind." Haqq!
So why are you in need of westernization? Western people are neither interested in heavenly ways nor in
spirituality, because they are mostly running after materialism (which is to be selfish). Therefore, they never
make people happy, and their ways are from Shaytan. Shaytan never likes one to please another one (as it
brings peace between them).
O Salafi `ulamas! What are you are not saying? Allah Almighty says, wa`izhum, "Give advice to people, and
teach your powerful ones to do as much as possible for their charities. Let them do more and more and give
more and more pleasure to weak people who are in need."
Allah, yaa Rabb! Forgive us and send us Your good ones to correct our steps and change our direction from
following shaytanic ways to follow prophets and the Seal of Prophets' line! O our Lord! You can do
everything, and we are waiting for You. As you said, we are preparing ourselves to hear and listen to the
heavenly command coming to people. May Allah forgive us, for the honor of His most honored one, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.

(33 minutes) (883 viewers) Mashaa-Allah. Today is a holiday, people are running after Shaytan, but thanks to
Allah Almighty for correcting our hearts, slowly everyone is coming to accept what is true! Thanks to our
listeners and blessings upon them in this holy month! We are praying and awliyas are praying for them. They
must continue, they must prepare their food in the right way in order to reach heavenly pleasure here and
Hereafter!
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salat ash-Shukr)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks with Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha on the phone. Shaykh Hisham says
a very great scholar in Algeria has been watching Sufilive.com and is so happy to have become a Naqshbandi.
He has been trying to reach Mawlana Shaykh. He has reached Shaykh Hisham and asked to establish tariqah
there in Algeria. The government is now supporting tariqah there. Mashaa-Allah.)
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salat ash-Shukr.)
